parts.text: You wake up to your nasal passages feeling like you slept in front of a space heater all night.
Honestly, you might as well have. It stings from drought.
You rub your eyes and look around, the sun’s already out.

parts.speaker: lullaby
parts.dialogue: Couldn’t sleep well? Haha, me neither~

parts.speaker: lullaby
parts.dialogue: I guess all that excitement from last night’s dinner kept me up.

parts.speaker: lullaby
parts.dialogue: Oh, my friends all say that happens whenever I get anxious. Sorry about that.

parts.text: You get up and stretch. Seems like both of you slept in your normal clothes.

parts.speaker: lullaby
parts.dialogue: I had my natural sciences final there last semester, it’s a nice building. Renovated, too.

parts.text: Should we get something to eat beforehand? It’s right around lunch.
Lullaby gives you a funny look, tilting her head to the side with an amused smile.

parts.speaker: lullaby
parts.dialogue: Huh? I mean we *could*. But we should be focusing on the urgent matter of… *you* instead of fun things like getting lunch.
